A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''member''' of the [[Evocii]] [[Species/Legends|species]] lived well before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. One of the Evocii's kinsmen, [[Ejal]], led his fellow Evocii in an [[Ejal's uprising|uprising]] against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who had stolen the Evocii's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and used the Evocii as cheap labor. However, Ejal's kinsman betrayed Ejal to the Hutts, who brutally [[Death/Legends|killed]] the revolutionary and awarded the traitor with both his freedom and riches.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ejal and his kinsman were mentioned in the Codex entry for the Evocii species in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
